summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Sleep Number Corp reporting the results of its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders. The filing covers director elections, a failed proposal to declassify the board, and shareholder approval of an amendment to the 2020 Equity Incentive Plan to increase share reserve by 750,000 shares. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other transformative event is present. The filing is a standard current report on Items 5.02 and 5.07, documenting ordinary governance matters and compensatory plan changes. There are no deal terms or strategic catalysts to note.
